_comment: Element vocabulary for URDF + common extensions (gazebo, transmission, ros2_control). Keys are 'tag' or 'parent/tag' for context-specific definitions. Used for completion and hover; xacro files are not schema-validated against this.

robot.doc: Root element of a URDF robot description.

link.doc: A rigid body with inertial, visual and collision properties.

inertial.doc: Mass, center of mass and inertia of the link.

inertia.doc: 3x3 rotational inertia matrix about the center of mass, in the inertial frame (kg·m²). Only the 6 upper-triangle values are given.

visual.doc: Visual geometry of the link (may appear multiple times).

collision.doc: Collision geometry of the link (may appear multiple times).

origin.doc: Pose of the element relative to its parent frame.

rpy.doc: Fixed-axis roll pitch yaw in radians (default 0 0 0).

geometry.doc: Shape of a visual or collision element. Exactly one child.

size.doc: Side lengths 'x y z' in meters.

cylinder.doc: Cylinder centered at the origin, along Z.

mesh.doc: Mesh file (STL, DAE, OBJ, …). Use package://pkg/path or file:// URIs.

material.doc: Material (color/texture). Top-level materials can be referenced by name from visuals.

joint.doc: Connects two links with a kinematic constraint.

axis.doc: Joint axis in the joint frame (normalized). Default 1 0 0.

calibration.doc: Reference positions used to calibrate the absolute position of the joint.

dynamics.doc: Physical properties of the joint (used in simulation).

limit.doc: Joint limits (required for revolute and prismatic joints).

mimic.doc: This joint mimics another: value = multiplier * other + offset.

transmission.doc: Relationship between actuators and joints (ros_control / ros2_control transmission interface). New style: <type>, <joint> and <actuator> children.

type.doc: Old (PR2) style: transmission type as attribute.

mechanicalReduction.doc: Gear ratio between actuator and joint.

role.doc: Role of a joint/actuator in multi-DOF transmissions (e.g. joint1, actuator1).

gazebo.doc: Gazebo-specific extensions. Without 'reference' applies to the whole robot; with reference="link" or reference="joint" to that element. Gazebo Classic and Gazebo Sim (gz) both parse these via sdformat's URDF parser.

reference.doc: Name of a link or joint (omit for robot-level settings).

gazebo/material.doc: Gazebo material: Classic script name (e.g. Gazebo/Red) or, for gz, an SDF <material> with ambient/diffuse/specular children.

mu1.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient along the first friction direction (link).

mu2.doc: Coulomb friction coefficient along the second friction direction (link).

minDepth.doc: Minimum penetration depth before contact correction (link).

fdir1.doc: First friction direction 'x y z' in the collision frame (link).

maxContacts.doc: Maximum number of contacts between two entities (link).

selfCollide.doc: Allow the link to collide with other links of the model (true/false).

turnGravityOff.doc: Deprecated: disable gravity for the link.

dampingFactor.doc: Exponential velocity decay of the link.

laserRetro.doc: Intensity value returned by laser sensors.

implicitSpringDamper.doc: Use implicit spring damper for the joint (ODE).

preserveFixedJoint.doc: Keep this fixed joint instead of lumping its links together.

disableFixedJointLumping.doc: Disable fixed joint lumping for this joint.

gazebo/plugin.doc: Gazebo plugin. Content is plugin-specific. Gazebo Sim example: filename="gz_ros2_control-system" name="gz_ros2_control::GazeboSimROS2ControlPlugin" with <parameters>.

parameters.doc: Path to a controller manager YAML file (gz_ros2_control / gazebo_ros2_control).

gazebo/sensor.doc: SDF sensor attached to the referenced link.

ros2_control.doc: ros2_control hardware description, parsed by the controller manager from robot_description.

ros2_control/joint.doc: Joint managed by this hardware component.

ros2_control/sensor.doc: Sensor managed by this hardware component.

command_interface.doc: Command interface exported by the hardware.

state_interface.doc: State interface exported by the hardware.

param.doc: Named parameter (text content is the value). For interfaces: min, max, initial_value.

sensor.doc: URDF sensor (urdfdom). Rarely used; prefer <gazebo reference=...><sensor> for simulation.
